meta.description:
Welcome to Emoji Simulator! (Originally by Nicky Case, check it out at ncase.me!) 

Here's some examples to spark your imagination: (copy-paste links below)

🔥 Forest Fires (this one you're seeing!)
(← CLICK on the grid to create a fire)

💀 Epidemics
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=sick

🌸 Conway's Game of Life
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=conway

🔴 B-Z Chemical Spirals
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=bz

🐹 Schelling's Segregation Model
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=schelling

🦊 Predator-Prey Model
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=prey

🏖 Procedurally Generated Beaches
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=beach

🪨Rock-Paper-Scissors 7
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/rps7

😐 [Blank Sim] (to make your own)
https://thecomputercrasher.github.io/emoji-sim/?s=blank

You can edit the text in ANY of these textboxes, including this one. Change the rules & emoji below to make new sims. Finally, you can SAVE and SHARE your sim.

Have fun! 🎉
